categories.main_business_segments: KEPCO KPS primarily operates in power plant maintenance services including thermal power, nuclear/pumped storage, transmission and distribution, domestic external projects, and overseas power plant operation and maintenance. Subsidiaries engage in overseas power plant O&M and facility management services. The company is also expanding into new businesses such as nuclear decommissioning and renewable energy projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced maintenance technologies including predictive diagnostics using vibration, noise, temperature, pressure, and lubricant analysis. It employs specialized equipment like non-destructive testing devices, 3D measurement tools, rotor balancing machines, and develops proprietary technologies for turbine and generator component refurbishment. KEPCO KPS also operates dedicated research centers focusing on nuclear maintenance, gas turbine parts regeneration, and digital technology development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO), Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power, domestic power generation companies, private power producers, and overseas power utilities in countries such as India, Pakistan, UAE, Philippines, South Africa, and others. The company serves industries related to power generation, transmission, and renewable energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: KEPCO KPS operates primarily in South Korea with significant overseas presence through subsidiaries and projects in the Philippines, South Africa, India, Pakistan, UAE, Jordan, Madagascar, Uruguay, Mexico, Indonesia, and the United States. The company is expanding its footprint in emerging markets and maintains local subsidiaries to strengthen market share.
categories.supply_chain_position: KEPCO KPS operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power supply chain, focusing on operation, maintenance, repair, and refurbishment of power generation and transmission equipment. It does not manufacture power plants but provides comprehensive maintenance and engineering services, including parts regeneration and technical consulting.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in power plant maintenance technologies, digitalization, green energy O&M, and nuclear decommissioning technologies. It pursues strategic partnerships with global technology leaders like Westinghouse and GE for technology transfer and collaborates with domestic research institutes and universities. KEPCO KPS follows a 2030 mid-to-long-term technology roadmap focusing on advanced diagnostics, performance enhancement, life assessment, and renewable energy integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service contracts for maintenance, operation, and refurbishment of power plants and transmission facilities. This includes planned preventive maintenance, corrective repairs, performance improvement projects, and turnkey construction services. The company also earns income from overseas O&M contracts and facility management services provided by subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KEPCO KPS holds a dominant market position in South Korea's power plant maintenance industry, especially in nuclear and thermal power sectors, with significant market shares in transmission line maintenance. It faces competition from emerging private maintenance firms domestically but maintains competitive advantages through accumulated data, technical expertise, and comprehensive service capabilities. Globally, it competes with international maintenance service providers in overseas markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, KEPCO KPS reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.53 trillion KRW with a 7.3% year-over-year growth. Operating profit increased by 52.7%, and net income grew by 62.4%, reflecting strong financial performance. Total assets stood at about 1.6 trillion KRW with a stable capital structure and low debt ratio. The company has sustained steady growth supported by domestic and overseas contract expansions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KEPCO KPS differentiates itself by offering high-quality, reliable, and technologically advanced maintenance services backed by nearly five decades of experience. Its unique value lies in integrated total maintenance solutions combining predictive diagnostics, specialized equipment, and skilled technical personnel. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, strategic global partnerships, and comprehensive service portfolio enable it to deliver superior operational efficiency and safety to power plant operators.
